newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangdong Inv considers US$130 mln bonds.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong Inv considers US$130 mln bonds.

text.p: Guangdong Investment Ltd said its wholly-owned Guangdong Investment Finance (Cayman) Ltd may issue up to US$130 million in guaranteed convertible bonds due 2002, raising capital to fund existing projects.
The company said the bonds would be convertible into shares of Guangdong Investment and an application would be made to list the bonds on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange.

The net proceeds to be raised would be used to meet existing capital contribution obligations in joint ventures and other projects, to fund investment in timber-related and furniture manufacturing businesses, to repay debt and for working capital.

Among the projects, Guangdong Investment said it had invested further in a joint venture which operates a power plant in Zhongshan in China, providing general working capital and funds to buy additonal generator.
The company also said it would increase its interest in a road related joint venture to 25 percent from 20 percent subject to the approvals from relevant Chinese authorities.
The joint venture is involved in the construction and operation of Guangzhou-Zhuhai section of the Beijing-Zhuhai Expressway, it said.
